title: Readers of The Sacred Mushroom find mushrooms in their backyards

tellings.quote: even met Puharic people who read his book uh the sacred mushroom and within uh days of reading his book they find these mushrooms growing in their backyard.

plain: People who read The Sacred Mushroom, a book by the scientist Andrija Puharich, are said to have found those same mushrooms growing in their backyards within days of reading it. The psychologist and author Jeffrey Mishlove tells it, saying Puharich himself told him he had met such readers. It would suggest a strange coincidence tied to the book.
